GENERAL NOTES:
1. THIS IS A STANDARD CIVIL SYMBOLOGY SHEET. ALL SYMBOLS ARE NOT NECESSARILY USED ON THIS PROJECT.
2. SCREENING OR SHADING OF WORK IS USED TO INDICATE EXISTING COMPONENTS OR TO DE-EMPHASIZE PROPOSED
IMPROVEMENTS TO HIGHLIGHT SELECTED TRADE WORK. REFER TO CONTEXT OF EACH SHEET FOR USAGE.
3. UTILITY LINES ARE BURIED UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE.
4. THE CONTRACTOR SHALL NOTIFY THE CITY AT LEAST 48 HOURS IN ADVANCE OF ANY CONNECTION TO ANY EXISTING WATER
LINE.
5. THE UTILITY LOCATIONS SHOWN ON THESE PLANS ARE TAKEN FROM UTILITY COMPANY RECORDS AND ARE APPROXIMATE
ONLY. THEY DO NOT CONSTITUTE ACTUAL FIELD LOCATIONS. THE CONTRACTOR SHALL VERIFY THE LOCATION AND DEPTH OF
ALL UTILITIES PRIOR TO CONSTRUCTION. PRIOR TO COMMENCING CONSTRUCTION. CONTRACTOR SHALL MARK THE LOCATION
OF THE PROPOSED WATER LINE, HYDRANTS, VALVES AND WATER METERS, AND SHALL REVIEW THESE LOCATIONS WITH THE
CITY.
6. CONTRACTOR SHALL INSTALL PIPE, BENDS AND FITTINGS AS NECESSARY TO MAINTAIN ALIGNMENT AS SHOWN ON PLAN AND
PROFILE AND AS NECESSARY TO MAKE A COMPLETE OPERATIONAL SYSTEM. INSTALL THRUST BLOCKS OR RESTRAINED JOINT
PIPE AS REQUIRED AT BENDS AND FITTINGS. IF CONTRACTOR CHOOSES TO INSTALL RESTRAINED JOINT PIPE, CONTRACTOR
SHALL SUBMIT A LAYING SCHEDULE OF RESTRAINED JOINT PIPE FOR BOTH HORIZONTAL AND VERTICAL BENDS WITH THE PIPE
MATERIAL SUBMITTED. RESTRAINED JOINT LENGTHS MUST MEET REQUIREMENTS OF THE APPLICABLE DETAIL AND PIPE
MANUFACTURERS RECOMMENDATIONS.
7. CONTRACTOR SHALL MAINTAIN ”AS CONSTRUCTED DRAWINGS” TO BE SUPPLIED TO THE CITY AT THE END OF THE PROJECT
NOTING INSTALLED VALVE AND FITTING LOCATIONS.
8. CONTRACTOR SHALL COORDINATE WITH LOCAL ELECTRIC UTILITY TO SUPPORT POWER POLES IN AREA OF EXCAVATION.
CONTRACTOR SHALL RESET GUY WIRE AND ANCHORS DISTURBED DURING CONSTRUCTION PER LOCAL UTILITY REQUIREMENTS.
9. ALL WATER MAIN SHOWN AS ”TO BE ABANDONED” SHALL REMAIN IN SERVICE UNTIL AFTER NEW WATER MAIN INSTALLED IN
THIS CONTRACT IS COMPLETE AND IN SERVICE.
10. THE OWNER HAS OBTAINED PERMANENT AND TEMPORARY EASEMENTS FOR THE SITE OF WORK. CONTRACTOR SHALL CONFINE
CONSTRUCTION ACTIVITIES TO THE EASEMENT LIMITS AND PUBLIC RIGHT-OF-WAY. CONTRACTOR SHALL OBTAIN FROM THE
ENGINEER A COPY OF ALL EASEMENT FORMS FOR EACH PROPERTY AND REVIEW WITH OWNER AND ENGINEER PRIOR TO
CONSTRUCTION. CONTRACTOR SHALL MINIMIZE DISRUPTION AND REMOVAL OF TREES WITHIN THE EASEMENT LIMITS. ANY
ADDITIONAL EASEMENTS OBTAINED BY CONTRACTOR FOR CONSTRUCTION ACTIVITIES SHALL BE IN WRITING AND A COPY
PROVIDED TO OWNER AND ENGINEER PRIOR TO CONSTRUCTION.
11. PROVIDE SILT FENCING PERPENDICULAR TO THE FLOW OF RUN OFF AND PLACED DOWN SLOPE OF DISTURBED AREAS. ANY
STORM INLET WITHIN 50’ OF DISTURBED AREAS SHALL BE PROTECTED WITH EROSION CONTROL DEVICES.
12. CONTRACTOR SHALL KEEP EXISTING WATER MAINS IN SERVICE THROUGHOUT CONSTRUCTION.
13. CONSTRUCTION STAKING IS THE RESPONSIBILITY OF THE CONTRACTOR. ENGINEER WILL PROVIDE THE PROJECT SURVEY AND
DESIGN CAD FILE ELECTRONICALLY TO THE CONTRACTOR FOR THE CONTRACTOR’S CONVENIENCE, FOR INFORMATION ONLY.
CONTRACTOR SHALL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR RESETTING ALL PROPERTY CORNERS, SECTION CORNERS OR OTHER SURVEY
MONUMENTS DISTURBED BY THE CONTRACTOR DURING CONSTRUCTION BY A LICENSED SURVEYOR IN THE STATE OF
MISSOURI.
14. CONTRACTOR SHALL PROVIDE TRAFFIC CONTROL PLAN PER THE MANUAL ON UNIFORM TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICES (MUTCD)
WHEN ANY LANE/ROAD CLOSURE IS REQUIRED TO COMPLETE THE WATER MAIN CONSTRUCTION. EACH LANE CLOSURE SHALL
BE LIMITED TO THE 7 HOUR PERIOD BETWEEN 9AM AND 4PM. ROAD SHALL BE KEPT OPEN TO TRAFFIC AT ALL TIMES BY
ONLY CLOSING ONE LANE AT A TIME AND PROVIDING FLAGMEN PER MUTCD. SEE SHEET 02C502 FOR GENERAL TRAFFIC
CONTROL NOTES AND DETAILS.
15. CONTRACTOR SHALL POTHOLE EXISTING WATER MAINS, SEWER MAINS, GAS MAINS, AND OTHER BURIED UTILITIES PRIOR TO
WATER MAIN INSTALLATION (OPEN EXCAVATION, HORIZONTAL DIRECTIONAL DRILLED OR BORED) AND ADJUST DEPTH OF NEW
WATER METER CROSSINGS TO MAINTAIN MINIMUM 18” CLEARANCE FROM EXISTING UTILITIES HORIZONTALLY AND VERTICALLY.
16. COORDINATE ALL WORK TO ENSURE WATER SERVICE IS MAINTAINED TO CUSTOMERS. MINIMIZE THE NUMBER OF WATER
SERVICE SHUTDOWNS, AND LIMIT SHUTDOWNS, TO 8 HOURS EACH.
17. PROVIDE TEMPORARY BARRICADES AROUND EXCAVATIONS DURING CONSTRUCTION. BARRICADES SHALL BE IN ACCORDANCE
WITH LAWS AND REGULATIONS TO PREVENT INJURY TO PERSONS AND PROPERTY, INCLUDING UNDERGROUND FACILITIES, AND
PROHIBIT ACCIDENTAL OR UNAUTHORIZED ENTRY OF PERSONS INTO EXCAVATIONS.
